content.short: Avantis is a decentralized derivatives platform on Base offering up to 500x leverage on crypto and real-world assets.
content.description: Avantis is a decentralized derivatives protocol on the Base network designed for trading perpetual futures with high leverage. The platform allows users to trade a range of assets, including cryptocurrencies, forex, and commodities, with up to 500x leverage. By leveraging the scalability of Base, Avantis provides a professional trading experience with low fees and fast execution. The protocol utilizes Universal Vaults where liquidity providers deposit USDC to act as the counterparty for traders, earning a share of fees. Avantis employs a dual-oracle system with Chainlink and Pyth for accurate pricing and risk management. Avantis is a premier leverage hub for DeFi users.
content.meta: Avantis offers high-leverage perpetual trading for crypto and real-world assets on Base. Discover Avantis and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
